opportunities.name: Paper lookup: arXiv advanced search, Semantic Scholar citations, note
opportunities.description: For a topic and year, find a paper via arXiv advanced search, look it up on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, then save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Search > Advanced search
Enter the topic term in the search box
Tick the date filter checkbox, choose specific year and enter the year
Click Search and open the top result
Go to Semantic Scholar and search the paper title
Open the paper to read author and citation count
Add a note 'topic (year): title by author, N citations' in the notes app

opportunities.name: Case law lookup: CourtListener, Cornell statute, note
opportunities.description: For a court case, find it on CourtListener for citation and date, look up the related US Code statute on Cornell LII, then save a note.
steps: Search the case name in CourtListener and press Enter
Open the matching case result
Note the U.S. citation and decision date
Search the statute citation on Cornell LII
Open the statute page
Add a note 'case: citation, decided date. See statute (title)' in the notes app
